title: Smart Order Router
description: An advanced DEX aggregation platform that discovers liquidity across multiple decentralized exchanges, analyzes optimal trading routes, and executes swaps with minimal slippage and gas costs.
longDescription: Smart Order Router combines on-chain smart contracts with an off-chain optimization engine to find the best trading paths in real-time. It features a 5-phase pipeline for pool discovery, graph construction, route finding, quote calculation, and swap execution.

features.title: Liquidity Discovery
features.description: Automatically scan DEX factories to discover available liquidity pools

features.title: Graph-Based Routing
features.description: Build directed graphs of token pairs and compute swap routes

features.title: Route Optimization
features.description: Query live on-chain quotes and rank routes by profitability

features.title: Smart Execution
features.description: Execute multi-hop swaps via smart contracts with atomic transactions

features.title: Web Dashboard
features.description: Interactive UI for visualizing pools, routes, and executing swaps

features.title: Real-time Updates
features.description: Continuous pool discovery and quote refresh with automation
